test_lacking_copy_ctor: test that non-copyable C++ objects raise RuntimeError when pybind11 tries to copy them
test_lacking_move_ctor: test that non-movable and non-copyable C++ objects raise RuntimeError when pybind11 tries to move them
test_move_and_copy_casts: test pybind11 type caster move and copy construction counts for MoveOnlyInt, MoveOrCopyInt, and CopyOnlyInt
test_move_and_copy_loads: test argument loading via pybind11 type casters and verify move and copy counts for pairs and tuples
test_move_and_copy_load_optional: test move and copy loads of std::optional arguments through pybind11 type casters
